messages:
tia: Quick heads up: interview training session signups aren't showing for new hires in the onboarding app. People managers reported blank slot lists.

kevin: that's the training scheduler UI (training-app) after the auth change. New hires have `onboarding_role='candidate'` but training-app expects `role='new-hire'`. The filter mismatch returns empty sets.

lara: is this just a UI filter or are new hire records missing in the DB?

kevin: DB still has records. Query: `SELECT id, role, onboarding_role FROM users WHERE created_at > '2025-03-01' AND onboarding_role IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5;` shows rows with `onboarding_role='candidate'`. The frontend update forgot to map the new field.

tia: can we hotfix the frontend to map `onboarding_role` -> `role` for now? Or should we run a small backfill to set `role='new-hire'`?

lara: prefer frontend patch; less candidate-facing risk. We'll submit a quick PR to training-app to accept either field and release as v1.2.3.

kevin: I'll open PR and add a feature flag `training_new_role_compat=true` so we can roll back quickly.

hrbot: Task created: TASK-2025-88 | owners: kevin,lara | due: 2025-03-17 | summary: training-app onboarding role compatibility patch

tia: also can we check that sessions scheduled during the outage were not lost? Recruiters indicated 3 signup confirmations failed earlier.

kevin: syncing signup queue now: `python tools/process_signup_queue.py --dry-run --since '2025-03-14T00:00:00Z'`. Found 3 pending confirmations that didn't send. Will retry after the frontend patch.

lara: thanks. Once PR is merged can we confirm signups are visible and then notify managers. Also add a regression test for onboarding_role compatibility.

tia: please also add a note to the new hire handbook about expected training-app flow so hiring managers can triage in the future.

kevin: will add a short blurb in the HR Ops playbook under 'onboarding tools'.

lara: :thumbsup: Thanks all, keep the thread updated.
